ceiling_directive: Extend the results to the published Cattaneo–Feng–Palomba–Titiunik staggered synthetic-control class by replacing known covariance with a uniformly valid covariance confidence set and proving that the robustified nested-support program retains honest coverage and a frontier comparison.
improvement_directive: Strengthen the coverage and constant-factor theorems to allow covariance estimated from pretreatment observations under primitive published error conditions, and prove uniform validity for the same treated-unit–horizon estimand. This would turn the custom known-covariance experiment into a result applicable to an established synthetic-control class.
critique: The note proves an exact finite-dimensional Gaussian decision frontier and an honest Bonferroni SOCP approximation, but only for deterministic weights in a bespoke bounded-mean experiment with known covariance. The existing staggered-SC literature already supplies broad non-asymptotic simultaneous inference and conic architecture, so the incremental content is the specialized joint-bias optimization, spectral approximation factor, and support comparison rather than a frontier for a published estimator class. The necessary-and-sufficient degeneracy-safe certificate concerns strict improvement of the Bonferroni surrogate Gamma, while strict improvement of the exact frontier W is established only under zero bias with Loewner or disjoint-diagonal structure and for one constructed witness. The order-sharpness result uses a purpose-built sequence with exponentially many treated units and does not establish that the large gap arises in a conventional panel regime. References to scpi and augsynth::multisynth as consumers therefore exceed what is operationally transferred, even though the prose correctly disclaims coverage for those procedures.
